programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Kyoto is a city that was the capital of Japan for a thousand years.In addition to beautiful historic temples, there are fascinating "flower cities" - districts where you can meet "butterflies of the night", i.e. geisha.They look like women from out of this world - their white faces and colorful kimonos are hypnotizing.Martyna had the opportunity to visit this phenomenal city and meet 20-year-old Kimichie, who is currently a "maiko", which means that she is training to be a geisha.Many young Japanese women when asked "what do you want to be?"he will answer - "geisha".They think it's a calling.Viewers will learn why geishas whiten their faces and what their daily schedule is like.They will accompany them in their traditional activities, at the hairdresser's and shopping, and will also attend a party where geishas "work".The host will ask Kimicha many questions about their secrets.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Another woman Martyna Wojciechowska meets during her trip to Japan is 25-year-old Watanabe, a member of the himegyaru.This term describes girls and women styled as princesses - they wear tiaras, pink clothes and shiny jewelry, and their apartments look like Barbie doll houses.They are dominated by kawaii, i.e. everything that is sweet, nice and tiny.Watanabe will reveal to Martyna what she does every day.It will also help find the answer to the question why Japanese teenagers do not want to grow up and where the popularity of himegyaru comes from.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: The second edition of a series of reportages by Martyna Wojciechowska presenting the customs and life situation of women living in remote corners of the earth.

programs.title: Japan on a plate
programs.desc: Alexa Łuczak moved to the Land of the Rising Sun over ten years ago.During this time, she mastered the language on her own, which allowed her to host one of the local television programs.The model decided to share her knowledge about extraordinary Asian cuisine.Her search for local flavors will take her to small bars hidden in the city's alleys, to the largest fish bazaar in all of Japan and to the establishments of the most talented sushi masters.The host will also visit elegant restaurants in Tokyo.There is no shortage of vending machines and fresh seafood in this city.Viewers will also learn more about Japan itself, its traditions and culture.

programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild 2
programs.desc: Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a journalist.In the program, fate throws them to distant and dangerous corners of the world.

programs.title: Inside Beverly Hills: The Land of the Rich \u0026 Famous
programs.desc: In Beverly Hills, the most important thing is money, a luxurious lifestyle and celebrity status.The creators of the program allow you to observe what Hollywood celebrities do, how they work and relax.
